hard_constraints.required_disclosure: Earth cannot reproduce lunar gravity; analog data must label gravity as a non-transferable mismatch.
Earth cannot reproduce the lunar vacuum; disclose this failure explicitly.
Earth cannot reproduce the Martian atmosphere; disclose this failure explicitly.
Earth cannot reproduce the lunar or Martian radiation environment; disclose this mismatch explicitly.

earth_analog_sources.title: Known Terrestrial Analog Sites for Planetary Science
earth_analog_sources.assessment: 190 impact craters, one dune field, one volcanic site; AnalogBody blank for 191/192. Treat as a sparse feature catalog, not a comprehensive analog database.
earth_analog_sources.exclusion_note: Do not claim this catalog alone discovers representative analog environments.

earth_analog_sources.title: Planetary Aeolian Analog Database (PAAD)
earth_analog_sources.assessment: USGS TADP first ingestion: 45 dune fields worldwide with bedforms, climate class, sand source/composition, elevation, coverage.

earth_analog_sources.title: ESA Catalogue of Planetary Analogues
earth_analog_sources.assessment: About 30 site chapters with coordinates and dossiers, cross-indexed by lunar and Martian features.

earth_analog_sources.title: NASA Planetary Analog Explorer
earth_analog_sources.assessment: About 11 curated Earth-to-world image pairs; public-facing visual context, not a quantitative dataset.

earth_analog_sources.title: PANGAEA mineralogical database (ESA EAC)
earth_analog_sources.assessment: Analog minerals and Raman/VNIR spectral library.

earth_analog_sources.title: Mars Society stations
earth_analog_sources.assessment: MDRS Utah and FMARS Devon Island are operational analogs; not geospatial measurement datasets.

analog_gap: USGS OFR 2024-1042 survey reports no central repository for terrestrial analog field data; 84% of respondents said they would use one. Candidate analog discovery should use feature-specific evidence and disclose this repository gap.
scoring_policy: No combined score until activity-specific weights and acceptance thresholds are supplied. Missing evidence is null, never zero. Every analog comparison records transferable properties and explicit physical mismatches.
